executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
The St. Regis Mexico City appeared in at least one AI answer for 92.1% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, The St. Regis Mexico City appeared 50% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see The St. Regis Mexico City in the hotel options surfaced.

The clearest strength in this period is often placed near the top when ai ranks hotels. See the summary at left for the supporting numbers. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, The St. Regis Mexico City appeared in the Top 3 75.6% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.
